Written before any release S retriever was run; every third query is held out and was not used to choose weights.
judgement_rule: A passage is relevant when it is Greek edited text (kind text, quality source_text or machine_corrected_ocr) whose normalised text (backend.textutils.normalize: lower case, no accents, final sigma as σ) matches the query's pattern: the concept, headword or epithet is actually present in the Greek. Relevance is judged on the passage (a fragment and its other editions are one item: only the first-ranked copy counts). Patterns are written from the Greek vocabulary of the concept, independently of the lemma index. Imagery and motif queries list several patterns in all_of; a passage is relevant only when every one matches.
metric: nDCG@10 with binary gains; ideal DCG assumes min(10, number of relevant items) relevant results. Also P@10 and the rank of the first relevant result. recall@50: distinct relevant passages in the first 50 / min(50, relevant passages).
